verdict.rationale: The docs show a product-based API structure (separate endpoints for account ownership, balance, transactions, ACH, etc.), which implicitly allows requesting only specific data products rather than a single blob, but there is no explicit documentation of scoped consent tokens, granular permission grants, or data-minimization controls presented to developers. missing for 10: explicit consent-scoping API/parameters, documentation of minimal-data-grant mechanisms, evidence of per-scope authorization tokens, and any independent confirmation of data-minimization enforcement.
